form.label: PulseForge — Security incident simulation
form.description: Inspect indexed synthetic incident observations; acceptance and simulated recovery are not indexing proof. Local indexed synthetic data only. KPI panels require HEC metrics and retained dimensions. Empty KPI results mean unavailable data, not zero impact. VERIFIED_HEALTHY is a simulated phase, not indexing verification. Remote destination data is not searched.

html.a: Back to discovery — related scenarios and telemetry prerequisites

search.query: search index=$index|s$ (sourcetype="netspout:network:syslog") (netspout_scenario_id="08_firewall_policy" OR netspout_scenario_id="09_ddos_flood" OR netspout_scenario_id="17_hospital_mac_auth" OR netspout_scenario_id="18_payment_deny" OR netspout_scenario_id="19_ips_service" OR netspout_scenario_id="22_authentication_storm" OR netspout_scenario_id="23_containment_request" OR netspout_scenario_id="24_policy_disagreement" OR netspout_scenario_id="27_stale_sessions") sourcetype=$log_source|s$ netspout_run_id=$run_id|s$ netspout_scenario_id=$scenario_id|s$ netspout_device_id=$entity|s$ | stats count as observed_records count(netspout_run_id) as present_netspout_run_id count(netspout_scenario_id) as present_netspout_scenario_id count(netspout_phase) as present_netspout_phase count(netspout_device_id) as present_netspout_device_id count(netspout_incident_id) as present_netspout_incident_id count(netspout_site_id) as present_netspout_site_id count(severity) as present_severity | eval data_status=case(observed_records=0,"MISSING_DATA",present_netspout_run_id=observed_records AND present_netspout_scenario_id=observed_records AND present_netspout_phase=observed_records AND present_netspout_device_id=observed_records AND present_netspout_incident_id=observed_records AND present_netspout_site_id=observed_records AND present_severity=observed_records,"FIELDS_PRESENT",1=1,"MISSING_FIELDS")

panel.title: Incident start, duration and affected entities

search.query: search index=$index|s$ (sourcetype="netspout:network:syslog") (netspout_scenario_id="08_firewall_policy" OR netspout_scenario_id="09_ddos_flood" OR netspout_scenario_id="17_hospital_mac_auth" OR netspout_scenario_id="18_payment_deny" OR netspout_scenario_id="19_ips_service" OR netspout_scenario_id="22_authentication_storm" OR netspout_scenario_id="23_containment_request" OR netspout_scenario_id="24_policy_disagreement" OR netspout_scenario_id="27_stale_sessions") sourcetype=$log_source|s$ netspout_run_id=$run_id|s$ netspout_scenario_id=$scenario_id|s$ netspout_device_id=$entity|s$ | stats min(_time) as first_observation max(_time) as last_observation dc(netspout_device_id) as observed_entities min(eval(if(netspout_phase="FAILURE",_time,null()))) as first_failure by netspout_incident_id netspout_scenario_id | eval observed_span_seconds=last_observation-first_observation | convert ctime(first_observation) ctime(last_observation) ctime(first_failure)

panel.title: Impact and recovery by phase — synthetic severity (lower is worse)

search.query: search index=$index|s$ (sourcetype="netspout:network:syslog") (netspout_scenario_id="08_firewall_policy" OR netspout_scenario_id="09_ddos_flood" OR netspout_scenario_id="17_hospital_mac_auth" OR netspout_scenario_id="18_payment_deny" OR netspout_scenario_id="19_ips_service" OR netspout_scenario_id="22_authentication_storm" OR netspout_scenario_id="23_containment_request" OR netspout_scenario_id="24_policy_disagreement" OR netspout_scenario_id="27_stale_sessions") sourcetype=$log_source|s$ netspout_run_id=$run_id|s$ netspout_scenario_id=$scenario_id|s$ netspout_device_id=$entity|s$ | stats min(severity) as most_severe dc(netspout_device_id) as observed_entities min(_time) as phase_start max(_time) as phase_end by netspout_scenario_id netspout_phase | eval phase_order=case(netspout_phase="BASELINE",0,netspout_phase="WARNING",1,netspout_phase="DEGRADATION",2,netspout_phase="FAILURE",3,netspout_phase="NETWORK_IMPACT",4,netspout_phase="USER_IMPACT",5,netspout_phase="INTERVENTION",6,netspout_phase="RECOVERY",7,netspout_phase="RECONVERGENCE",8,netspout_phase="VERIFIED_HEALTHY",9) | sort 0 netspout_scenario_id phase_order

panel.title: Simulated KPI progression — missing rows are not zero

search.query: | mstats avg(_value) as simulated_value WHERE metric_name=* index=$metric_index|s$ (sourcetype="netspout:network:metric") (netspout_scenario_id="08_firewall_policy" OR netspout_scenario_id="09_ddos_flood" OR netspout_scenario_id="17_hospital_mac_auth" OR netspout_scenario_id="18_payment_deny" OR netspout_scenario_id="19_ips_service" OR netspout_scenario_id="22_authentication_storm" OR netspout_scenario_id="23_containment_request" OR netspout_scenario_id="24_policy_disagreement" OR netspout_scenario_id="27_stale_sessions") netspout_run_id=$run_id|s$ netspout_scenario_id=$scenario_id|s$ netspout_device_id=$entity|s$ BY metric_name netspout_scenario_id netspout_phase netspout_device_id span=1s | eval phase_order=case(netspout_phase="BASELINE",0,netspout_phase="WARNING",1,netspout_phase="DEGRADATION",2,netspout_phase="FAILURE",3,netspout_phase="NETWORK_IMPACT",4,netspout_phase="USER_IMPACT",5,netspout_phase="INTERVENTION",6,netspout_phase="RECOVERY",7,netspout_phase="RECONVERGENCE",8,netspout_phase="VERIFIED_HEALTHY",9) | sort 0 netspout_scenario_id metric_name phase_order _time

search index=$index|s$ (sourcetype="netspout:network:syslog") (netspout_scenario_id="08_firewall_policy" OR netspout_scenario_id="09_ddos_flood" OR netspout_scenario_id="17_hospital_mac_auth" OR netspout_scenario_id="18_payment_deny" OR netspout_scenario_id="19_ips_service" OR netspout_scenario_id="22_authentication_storm" OR netspout_scenario_id="23_containment_request" OR netspout_scenario_id="24_policy_disagreement" OR netspout_scenario_id="27_stale_sessions") sourcetype=$log_source|s$ netspout_run_id=$run_id|s$ netspout_scenario_id=$scenario_id|s$ netspout_device_id=$entity|s$ | sort 0 _time | head 500 | table _time netspout_incident_id netspout_scenario_id netspout_phase netspout_device_id severity maintenance_scope _raw
